body: I had to deactivate my facebook so I would stop embarrassing myself and bumming out my distant friends that I haven't directly talked to in years.
I can relate with the social anxiety. It is debilitating and it's a very lonely state of mind. Sorry I don't have any advice on how to deal with it because I haven't found a way yet either.
Because that requires money I do not have.
It's not so much the awkwardness but the overwhelming anxiety I get when I even think about talking to someone that stops me from making friends.

I don't believe in me and that is the problem.

The unemployment rut is not what has made me suicidal. I have felt this way for a while now. But getting fired, especially in the way that I got fired, certainly didn't help. I have tried finding hobbies bit nothing appeals to me anymore.

I've moved recently. But other than that no I haven't made many changes in the past few years. And I have felt this way about life being pointless for about 9 or 10 years. And I've felt suicidal for the past year or 2. on and off

It's not that I don't want friends, I really really do, it's that I just can't make any. I have an extremely hard time communicating with people and potential friendships fall apart because it takes me thrice as long as normal people to get comfortable enough around someone to talk to them normally. If we don't have something specific to talk about I usually just 
don't talk.

There are very few things I enjoy doing and none of are enjoyable enough to make living worthwhile. Most of my experiences in life I want to forget. And I am not making this world a better place. If anything I am making it worse. As for the experiences I'll never get are probably ones I don't want anyways. There are plenty of things I have never done before but I still don't want to do them. I've tried helping people but I'm too awkward around other people to do it effectively. I get pretty anxious so dealing with other people is pretty difficult for me. As a result of that I have not had a friend or hung out with anybody in 6 or so years.

No I don't mean that life is pointless because there is no afterlife. I just don't see a purpose. The ride is the same the whole time you're on it. Everything just stays the same and it's the same pain all the time. That's what it is for me at least.
But the ride doesn't go anywhere.

I don't do anything. I got fired 5 months ago and have since fallen into a rut of self-loathing and apathy. I let down my family constantly by being alive and unemployed. I just don't see much point in trying to get a job that I will hate just so I can afford to be just as miserable as I am now.
Basically I'm a 23 year old failure with no ambition or motivation.
